subject: Pen test & SOC 2: clarify scope, evidence handoff, and ops plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: security@luminahealth.com
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pen test & SOC 2: clarify scope, evidence handoff, and ops plan

Hi Jared — good to reconnect. Quick note ahead of our legal/redline pass for the Order Form and MSA: we want to confirm a handful of details so that our counsel can align the security exhibit and the audit-rights language. Can you confirm the following on your side?

1) SOC 2 baseline: are you expecting us to provide a SOC 2 Type II report for the last 12 months (PDF) + a controls matrix, or do you need system-level extracts in addition to the report?

2) Pen test scope: do you require a tenant-level penetration test against production, or is a staging-only test acceptable if it mirrors prod infra? If you want prod testing, what systems are in scope (API endpoints, dashboard, SSO, batch imports)?

3) Access model for testers: will you accept short-term jumpbox/RDP with ephemeral credentials (recommended) or do you require privileged credentials/SSH access? Any preferred vendor(s) for testing?

4) Evidence cadence & handoff: do you want periodic evidence uploads (weekly during test window) to a secure Drive share, or a one-time bundle after the test? Also confirm preferred file formats and whether redaction is needed.

5) Notice windows: tradeoffs on notice period for inspection/access (we typically request >= 30 days notice for production access; can be narrower for staging).

We attached a draft redline (redline_MSA_v3.docx) with proposed edits to the security exhibit and an evidence_playbook_v1.pdf that describes our recommended cadence. Once we align on the bullets above, I'll loop in Kimberly and Marissa from legal & security to propose a mutual-action plan and an exemplar access addendum.

Thanks —
Ben
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
attachments: redline_MSA_v3.docx (docx), evidence_playbook_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Jared Mullins <jared.mullins@luminahealth.com>

Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test & SOC 2: clarify scope, evidence handoff, and ops plan

Ben — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers from our side so you can drive the redline:

1) SOC 2: we need the Type II report for the most recent 12-month period (PDF) plus the controls mapping (CSV or spreadsheet) that maps your controls to our SOC 2 framework. System extracts are not required initially; we'll flag if we need logs for specific incidents.

2) Pen test scope: staging-only is acceptable if the environment is production-equivalent and we can validate parity. We are *not* asking for production testing for initial engagement. Scope should include API endpoints (public and internal API gateway), web console (dashboard), and SSO/OAuth flows.

3) Access model: ephemeral jumpbox + time-limited accounts preferred. We do require that the testing account is scoped (no persistent privileged keys) and proof of vulnerability disclosure process from your side. Our vendor list includes SecureProbe LLC (they prefer staging tests).

4) Evidence cadence: prefer weekly uploads during a 2-week test window to a secure Drive folder with an SSO-restricted sharing group. Final bundle (PDF + CSV mapping + test report) at conclusion. Redaction allowed for internal IPs.

5) Notice windows: 14-day notice for staging pen-tests is fine. For any production-level access we'd require 30 days.

If you can send an updated redline that reflects 14-day windows for staging, ephemeral access, and the evidence cadence above, we can route to our legal and security and propose dates.

Jared
Head of Security Programs
Lumina Health

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Pen test & SOC 2: clarify scope, evidence handoff, and ops plan

Thanks — drafted suggested edits below you can paste into the MSA/Order Form security exhibit. Short snippets to keep legal review light:

- Penetration Testing (proposed): "Customer may request a penetration test of the Services limited to a customer-specific staging environment that is production-equivalent. Customer must provide at least fourteen (14) days' advance written notice. Testing shall be timeboxed to a mutually agreed two (2) week window unless otherwise agreed in writing."

- Access & Credentials: "Provider will provide ephemeral, scoped accounts and a jumpbox mechanism for authorized testers. Provider will not share persistent privileged credentials. Any escalation requiring elevated access will be handled via a documented change-control procedure and logged."

- Evidence & Delivery: "During the agreed test window Provider will upload intermediate evidence (test artifacts, intermediate findings) weekly to a secure, access-controlled repository. Provider will deliver a final report, controls mapping (CSV), and a redacted artifact bundle within five (5) business days of test completion. Sensitive data — including internal IP addresses and customer data — will be redacted from shared artifacts as reasonably practicable."

- Approved Vendor language (optional): "Customer may propose third-party testers; Provider reserves the right to approve testers on a case-by-case basis to avoid conflicts with ongoing operations."

Operational notes: propose we attach the evidence_playbook_v1.pdf and a short MAP spreadsheet (MAP_pen-test-window.xlsx) that outlines timelines and owner names (Ops: Maria Chen, Security: Marissa Cole, Legal: Kimberly Park).

If that looks good I can push these into redline_MSA_v3 and export a clean redline for Jared.

Kimberly Park
